placeholders.PYTHON: Python executable with the pinned project dependencies

comparison: Repeat with method independent and compact_json in separate run directories, on identical inputs and hardware. Every method uses the same schema buckets. Compact JSON generates ordered option letters with finite syntax constraints; it does not generate explanations or probability objects.
counts: One paragraph is one bounded worker; each real question is a field decision. Model weights are shared across workers, one replica per GPU. The root dispatcher is ordinary code, with no extra model call.
resume: Rerun the same launch command to skip completed batches. Use a new run directory when changing data, configuration or model.
quality_scope: SQuAD2.0 dev answerability classification only; not extractive answer EM/F1 or hidden-test evaluation. Labels are read solely by the separate evaluator.
probabilities: Uncalibrated conditional option scores from frozen token rows. No threshold or calibration fit.
execution: streamed calls native Qwen decoder layers, reuses each prefix layer state across question branches, then releases it. branch_batch_size explicitly sets per-layer branch tiling; changing tile size can change BF16 rounding.
license: Project code MIT; SQuAD2 paragraph/question material in the replay remains CC-BY-SA-4.0 with attribution.
warm_batch_scope: Recorded batch indices refer to the complete official dev workload using the supplied 4-GPU, batch-size-8 template. Run this command on GPU 0 after the complete streamed run; selected-batch timings are not a full-run extrapolation.
